title: Great experience
text: It was a great experience to explore Sagrada Familia and Park Guell especially with our tour guide Omar who is very enthusiastic and full of energy.
author: Minerva_G

title: 2nd visit just as Great
text:
As usual the Sagrada Familia is a high point in visiting Barcelona. A tour brings those highlights out in full view.
The exterior is over the top emblomatic religious iconography. So many parts you could miss without a guide. And probably so many more as well.
Inside is simply sublime. The colours change as the outside light changes. Pastels to brights. Just magical
author: Glenn_T

title: Very well put together
text: The tour covers what you expect. The host was knowledgeable and showed us around in a way that catered for the elderly in the group that couldn't walk as far

title: Great experience
text: Olga E was an excellent guide. Knowledgeable , easy to understand , told a story as if she lived it . Passionate about her position, set a good pace walking always checking everyone in the group was there.
author: RobB554

title: My husband and I did the...
text: My husband and I did the tour in the afternoon and it was very hot, BUT we still enjoyed it. Sagrada Familia is stunningly beautiful. Learning about Gaudi's designs and how he built the structural aspects show what an incredible man he was. I wish we would have had more time to just sit and watch the color through the windows as the sun moved. Visiting the Sagrada Familia was on my bucket list. Park Guell was also interesting and continued to demonstrate what a genius Gaudi was. Highly recommend.
author: Eleana_B
